title: Micro-interaction ARIA overhaul and evidence archive for accessibility compliance
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Scope: Audit and remediate ARIA semantics, keyboard navigation, and visual contrast for small, high-interaction components (compact buttons/pills, table row actions, sparkline legends, micro-chart tooltips). Deliver a consolidated evidence archive for the VPAT submission (manual scenarios, automated axe snapshots, test matrices). Work requires design tokens adjustments, markup pattern updates, and a small set of runtime JS helpers for roving tabindex/focus restoration used by the component library.
acceptance_criteria: All touched components pass the project axe baseline with no critical failures
Keyboard traversal is deterministic and follows a documented roving tabindex pattern for micro-interactions
ARIA roles and live-region semantics are documented in the design system site with code samples
Contrast tokens for compact mode are updated and there is a tokens migration guide
VPAT evidence archive (zip) contains manual test steps, screenreader recordings (or transcripts), automated reports, and links to approved PRs
timeline: Week 1: Inventory & prioritized list of 22 micro-interaction variants (buttons, chips, row-actions, chart-annotations)
Week 2: Implement roving-tabindex helper and canonical ARIA role patterns; land initial PRs for buttons and chips
Week 3: Token updates for compact contrast ramp; QA with assistive tech scenarios; assemble automated axe snapshots
Week 4: Manual screening with NVDA/VoiceOver + record transcripts; finalize VPAT evidence archive and get design + legal sign-off
